component.name: Breadcrumb
component.description: Breadcrumb navigation trail with separator icons and optional wrapping.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Navigation container for the breadcrumb trail.

slots.name: list
slots.description: Ordered list that contains breadcrumb items and separators.

slots.name: link
slots.description: Clickable breadcrumb target for navigable entries.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Optional icon rendered before a breadcrumb label.

own.name: aria-label
own.description: Accessibility label for the navigation element.

own.name: itemRender
own.description: Custom renderer for individual breadcrumb items.

own.name: items
own.description: Array of breadcrumb items to display.

own.name: separator
own.description: Icon name for the separator between items.

own.name: size
own.description: Size of the breadcrumb items and icons.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether the item is the current active page.

props.name: href
props.description: The destination URL for this item.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display next to the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Label to display for the breadcrumb item.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback when the item is clicked.

props.name: rel
props.description: Relationship of the linked URL to the current document.

props.name: target
props.description: Where to display the linked URL.

props.name: to
props.description: The destination URL for this item.

item.description: An individual item in the breadcrumb trail.
